pages.text: $(l)Crafts & Additions$(): electricity. Alternators turn rotation into power, electric motors turn it back.$(br2)$(l)Big Cannons$(): yes, real cannons. Build them out of cannon blocks, load shells, and do not aim at your base.$(br2)$(l)Copycats+ / Deco / Connected$(): more building blocks and more ways to hide your machines.

$(l)Slice & Dice / Central Kitchen$(): automate Farmer's Delight. The Slicer is a cutting board on a stick, and deployers can cook.$(br2)$(l)Farmer's Delight$() itself adds real meals. Full stomach = faster healing.
